text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had been several hours since I sat down at my desk
to draft a new training routine for <chrname>.
Just as I was thinking about taking a break...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's Hayakawa.
You have a guest♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'm Otonashi from Monthly Twinkle.
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Were you in the middle of working? My apologies for intruding during your busy time.
choice_data_list: Yes, I was thinking about the training menu.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The training menu...
Um, if it's not too much trouble,
would you mind if I took a look?
choice_data_list: Not at all, I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Well then, excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hm, I see, I see.
Magnificent... But if that's the case... Hm, hm!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much,
that was an extremely fascinating topic!
choice_data_list: If you don't mind, could I get your opinion?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure?
The opinion of a mere reporter like me
might just get in your way...
choice_data_list: A different perspective is important, after all

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
That voracious drive, like a black hole
seeking to absorb everything...
It's magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If I may.
Regarding the horseshoes, I believe it might be worth reconsidering their shape at this point.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"With this form,
even adopting an outer-rim type design
should put minimal strain on—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
As for what's next, I believe more Umamusume
will find stamina to be a real challenge
around this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Judging by her recent times,
increasing the number of uphill training sets might also be—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...That is all.
It is merely an amateur opinion, but I hope it proves useful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it was quite a long discussion,
it was an extremely meaningful exchange of opinions...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I always thought you were knowledgeable, Reporter Otonashi, but you really do know so much about Umamusume!
choice_data_list: Looks like you could aim to be a trainer too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I am honored. But no...
I prefer being a reporter.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: If only you weren't a reporter...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!
Reporter Otonashi, is the magazine going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah!
I am so sorry, of all the careless mistakes...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Today's main topic is these magazines right here!
I wanted you to see how the announcements for the 'Twinkle Star Climax' are looking."
choice_data_list: So this is what was inside the paper bag.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There's quite a lot here. Are they all racing magazines...
Oh, wait, no. It looks like there are Umamusume fashion magazines and manga magazines too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We have special features online in addition
to print books, so this is only a small part of it.
choice_data_list: There's this much and it's only a part of it?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I was surprised when I heard the news, too...!
choice_data_list: When you really look at it, the scale of this event is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: "Hearing you say that makes bowing to every single company worth it!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, this is far from everything.
Though the day of the event is still some time away—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
That is why I want to put even more effort into publicity,
to create the greatest stage that the entire nation will eagerly anticipate!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because this is the stage that decides who is the 'strongest'!
Following Trainer <username>'s example,
I intend to give it everything I have!!
choice_data_list: Wait, does that mean I have to give it my all too?
Am I supposed to be giving it my all to the bitter end too...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, absolutely!
...Wait, is it that late already?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I have back-to-back meetings for this project,
so I'll be heading back to the office for now.
Thank you very much for your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And there she goes.
She was like a whirlwind...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer,
have you read this magazine yet?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the magazine she handed me,
alongside all the powerhouse Umamusume,
there was an article featuring <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They say she's a candidate for "the strongest."
...What do you think?
choice_data_list: To be honest, I'm happy. But...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But...?
choice_data_list: Someday, I want a whole issue dedicated to me!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
My!
You're right, a small article is
a bit unsatisfying, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The Strongest Umamusume: <chrname> Special Edition"!
Hehe, I look forward to reading it one day♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is a girl who certainly
won't stop at just being a "candidate."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That day's training was overflowing
with even more motivation than usual...!
